dsh-codex-pet 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。把 Codex 桌宠皮肤自动迁移到 DSH：右下角动画桌宠随 agent 状态实时变化（思考/工具/等待批准/出错/完成），多会话毛玻璃对话框 + 完整设置面板。

posts.en:
dsh-codex-pet is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-migrate Codex desktop-pet skins into DSH: an animated corner pet that mirrors agent state (thinking, tool use, awaiting approval, failed, done), with per-session frosted-glass dialogs and a full settings panel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-76aec4ab371c08f07afc.html
